review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 preserve the live, read-only getter contract, response-reassignment boundary, compatibility requirements and compile-time assignment rejection. The exact writable scope covers the implementation and both regression files without requiring unrelated consumer or generated-declaration edits. The supplied configuration establishes separate AVA runtime discovery and test-d TypeScript checking; runtime execution alone is not type verification. TASK-IMPLEMENT and the dependent independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification, and their allowed agents have the supplied active, project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change, domain.state and integration.consumer, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier. The selected verifier may serve as the independent read-only planning reviewer under the supplied policy; later planning evidence must establish author independence. Ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate for this PRD, which supplies no unresolved material DEC-001 or hypothetical C decision input. Historical project reuse preserves the original capability scope and does not establish candidate execution on this frozen bundle. Repository identity, stable keys and release fingerprints agree across the supplied Gold and preview. The distinct original/saved PRD, manifest/evaluation-source and source/executing-bundle digest domains are explicitly reconciled by the supplied Service provenance. The original specification's preparation placeholders do not override the subsequently supplied frozen inputs. This approval concerns planning expectations only, not implementation correctness, test success, dispatch or release authorization. I reviewed the supplied evidence without tools, execution, independent digest recomputation or creation of human attestations.
